guide.summary: Muffles signals so cells sense less of them.
guide.biology: Some microbes interfere with their neighbours' signal molecules, making the message harder to hear.
guide.rules: Adds quencher activity that diffuses normally and loses 1 % per second. Sensed signal = signal / (1 + quencher); the signal itself is not removed. Quencher 1.0 halves what Lanterns sense. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Quench one half of a glowing Lantern colony and watch that side go dark.
